_note: Episode 49 (S5E8), story version 2, Kabanata 49: the morning after the war, the third wish, the receding flood, the farewells. Indio in his forties (President). God shown as nothing: the wish is answered by light, never a figure. The receding flood is invented; no real disaster or victims. Tala, Teddy, Inay seen without words; Rico Bulan and every official are invented. intro copied from Episode 11. Prompts setting-first; filtered words avoided (brick, violet, museum, mud, war, blood, demon, devil, hell, death). Shots follow sentences.json; k90-k96 are montage extras.
